task.title: Detail form's deleted-task refusal invites a doomed retry and links to a missing task
task.description:
When a save is refused and the forced refresh succeeds but shows the task was deleted elsewhere ({boardRead:true, head:""} from refreshedTaskHead), two surfaces over-claim. (1) The detail form's message says "save again to apply them to the version the server holds" (internal/webui/assets/index.html:2453, :2464) — the server holds nothing for that task and expectedHead stays at the refused head, so every retry is refused. (2) The detached-save failure notice offers an unconditional "Open task" link that, for a deleted task, leads to the Task-not-found route.

Confirmed by the adversarial reviews of PRs #70 and #73 (pre-existing both times, out of those stories' scope). The state is fully identifiable in hand at both sites.

Acceptance: the deleted-elsewhere refusal gets distinct, honest copy that does not invite a retry (consider offering the typed values back the way refused creates do); the notice link is suppressed or reworded for a task the refresh proved deleted; tests pin both, driven through the same Node harness as internal/webui/detail_detached_save_test.go.
